name: Grok Pot
tagline: Plans the household's food: shortlists dishes, builds the cart, waits for your yes
description: Acts as the kitchen desk for a household, narrowing nearby delivery choices down to a short list and loading the basket without spending a penny until you approve. Around that it also covers grocery pickup, the usual repeat orders, a weekly food budget and a memory of what the people in the house actually like to eat.
author: SageSummitCap
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
